component.name: xmlsecurity-sign
component.title: XML Security Sign
component.description: Sign an XML document or plain text with an enveloped, enveloping or detached XML signature.
component.label: security,transformation

addKeyInfoReference.description: Whether to add a reference to the KeyInfo element to the SignedInfo element, so that the signature value also protects the KeyInfo element against changes. Only used when keyAccessor returns a KeyInfo with an Id; DefaultKeyAccessor does so when the keystore has a certificate chain for the alias.

baseUri.label: producer
baseUri.description: The base URI that relative URIs of the references are resolved against, set on the XMLSignContext of the signer and the XMLValidateContext of the verifier (XMLCryptoContext.setBaseURI).

canonicalizationMethod.description: The canonicalization method of the SignedInfo element, which is canonicalized before the signature value is calculated. Create it with XmlSignatureHelper.getCanonicalizationMethod(algorithm) or getCanonicalizationMethod(algorithm, inclusiveNamespacePrefixes). The default is Canonical XML 1.0 (http://www.w3.org/TR/2001/REC-xml-c14n-20010315).

clearHeaders.label: producer
clearHeaders.description: Whether to remove the CamelXmlSignature headers of this component from the message after signing or verifying. The CamelCharsetName header is kept.

contentObjectId.description: The Id attribute of the Object element that holds the signed content of an enveloping signature, which the reference to the content points to. If not set, an Id made of an underscore and a random UUID is generated once and then used for all messages of the endpoint. Only used for an enveloping signature.

contentReferenceType.description: The Type attribute of the reference to the signed content, for example http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#Object. If not set, the reference has no Type attribute. The CamelXmlSignatureContentReferenceType header replaces this option.

contentReferenceUri.description: The URI of the reference to the signed content of an enveloped signature. If not set, the URI is empty, which signs the whole document. A URI that points to an ID, such as #id, also requires schemaResourceUri, which declares the ID attributes. The CamelXmlSignatureContentReferenceUri header replaces this option. Not used for an enveloping or detached signature.

cryptoContextProperties.label: producer
cryptoContextProperties.description: Properties that are set on the XMLSignContext of the signer and the XMLValidateContext of the verifier, see XMLCryptoContext.setProperty and the properties that the XML signature provider supports. The verifier sets javax.xml.crypto.dsig.cacheReference and org.jcp.xml.dsig.validateManifests to true itself; these properties are set after that, so a value given here replaces the value that the verifier sets for the same property.

digestAlgorithm.description: The URI of the digest algorithm of the references, for example http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#sha512. If not set, the signer takes the digest algorithm that the URI of signatureAlgorithm names (SHA-1, SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 or RIPEMD-160), and fails if it names none.

disallowDoctypeDecl.label: producer
disallowDoctypeDecl.description: Whether the parser rejects a message body that contains a DOCTYPE declaration. If false, a DOCTYPE declaration is allowed; external entities stay disabled either way.

keyAccessor.description: Provides the key that the signer signs with and the optional KeyInfo element that is added to the signature. Required: the signer fails without it. DefaultKeyAccessor of the package org.apache.camel.component.xmlsecurity.api reads the private key and the certificate chain of an alias from a java.security.KeyStore.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

omitXmlDeclaration.label: producer
omitXmlDeclaration.description: Whether to leave out the XML declaration of the output body. Has no effect when the output of the verifier is text. The CamelXmlSignatureOmitXmlDeclaration header replaces this option.

outputXmlEncoding.label: producer
outputXmlEncoding.description: The character encoding of the output body. If not set, UTF-8 is used. If set, the CamelCharsetName header is also set to it; for the verifier, the default xmlSignature2Message does this.

parentLocalName.description: The local name of the element to which an enveloped signature is added as the last child; setting it makes the signature enveloped. The first element of the document with this local name and the namespace of parentNamespace is used. Cannot be combined with parentXpath or xpathsToIdAttributes: the signer then fails.

parentNamespace.description: The namespace of the parentLocalName element. If not set, that element must have no namespace.

parentXpath.description: An XPath, as a javax.xml.crypto.dsig.spec.XPathFilterParameterSpec created with XmlSignatureHelper.getXpathFilter, that selects the element to which an enveloped signature is added as the last child; the first element of the result is used. Setting it makes the signature enveloped. Cannot be combined with parentLocalName or xpathsToIdAttributes: the signer then fails.

plainText.description: Whether the message body is plain text instead of an XML document. The signer then puts the text, decoded with plainTextEncoding, into the Object element of an enveloping signature; plain text cannot get an enveloped or detached signature. The CamelXmlSignatureMessageIsPlainText header replaces this option.

plainTextEncoding.description: The character encoding that the signer decodes a plain text message body with, see plainText. The CamelXmlSignaturePlainTextEncoding header replaces this option.

prefixForXmlSignatureNamespace.description: The namespace prefix of the elements of the XML signature namespace http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#. If empty, the signature elements have no prefix.

properties.description: A bean that implements org.apache.camel.component.xmlsecurity.api.XmlSignatureProperties, which adds further references and Object elements to each signature and can set the Id of the Signature element. For XAdES-BES and XAdES-EPES signatures, use XAdESSignatureProperties or DefaultXAdESSignatureProperties.

schemaResourceUri.label: producer
schemaResourceUri.description: The XML schema that the message body is validated against while it is parsed, loaded as a resource from the classpath by default. The schema also declares which attributes are of type ID, so it is required for a detached signature and when a reference URI points to an ID. The CamelXmlSignatureSchemaResourceUri header replaces this option.

signatureAlgorithm.description: The URI of the signature algorithm, which must fit the key of keyAccessor, for example http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmldsig-more#rsa-sha512 or http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmldsig-more#ecdsa-sha256. The default is RSA with SHA-256.

signatureId.description: The Id attribute of the Signature element. If not set, a new Id made of an underscore and a random UUID is generated for each signature; if empty, the Signature element has no Id attribute. The XmlSignatureProperties of the properties option can replace it, and XAdESSignatureProperties generates one when it is empty.

transformMethods.description: The transforms of the reference to the signed content, which are applied to the content before its digest is calculated. Create them with the methods of XmlSignatureHelper. The default is Canonical XML 1.0 (http://www.w3.org/TR/2001/REC-xml-c14n-20010315), and for an enveloped signature the signer puts the enveloped-signature transform first when the list does not contain it. The CamelXmlSignatureTransformMethods header replaces this option.

xpathsToIdAttributes.description: XPaths, as javax.xml.crypto.dsig.spec.XPathFilterParameterSpec created with XmlSignatureHelper.getXpathFilter, that select ID attributes; setting them makes the signatures detached. For each element with a selected ID attribute, the signer creates a signature whose reference URI is # followed by the attribute value, adds it as the last child of the parent of that element, and signs deeper elements first. Requires schemaResourceUri and cannot be combined with parentLocalName or parentXpath. The CamelXmlSignatureXpathsToIdAttributes header replaces this option.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

signerConfiguration.label: advanced
signerConfiguration.description: A shared XmlSignerConfiguration that the endpoints of the component start from: the component copies it for each new endpoint and then sets the options of the endpoint URI on the copy.

uriDereferencer.label: advanced
uriDereferencer.description: To use a custom javax.xml.crypto.URIDereferencer that resolves the URIs of the references, for example to control which resources can be read. If not set, the dereferencer of the XML signature provider is used; the Apache Santuario provider, which the component uses, resolves only same-document URIs (fragments and XPointer) by default.

CamelXmlSignatureMessageIsPlainText.description: Whether the message body is plain text instead of an XML document. Replaces the plainText option. Plain text can only get an enveloping signature.

CamelXmlSignaturePlainTextEncoding.description: The character encoding that the signer decodes a plain text message body with. Replaces the plainTextEncoding option.

CamelXmlSignatureOmitXmlDeclaration.description: Whether to leave out the XML declaration of the output body. Replaces the omitXmlDeclaration option. The verifier reads it through the default xmlSignature2Message, and it has no effect when the output of the verifier is text.

CamelXmlSignatureContentReferenceUri.description: The URI of the reference to the signed content of an enveloped signature. Replaces the contentReferenceUri option. Not used for an enveloping or detached signature.

CamelXmlSignatureContentReferenceType.description: The Type attribute of the reference to the signed content. Replaces the contentReferenceType option.

CamelXmlSignatureSchemaResourceUri.description: The XML schema that the message body is validated against while it is parsed. Replaces the schemaResourceUri option.

CamelXmlSignatureXpathsToIdAttributes.description: A java.util.List of javax.xml.crypto.dsig.spec.XPathFilterParameterSpec that selects the ID attributes of the elements that get a detached signature. Replaces the xpathsToIdAttributes option. Only the signer reads it.

CamelXmlSignatureTransformMethods.description: A comma-separated list of the URIs of the transforms of the reference to the signed content, for example http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#enveloped-signature,http://www.w3.org/TR/2001/REC-xml-c14n-20010315. Replaces the transformMethods option; for an enveloped signature, the enveloped-signature transform is then not added automatically. Only transforms without parameters are possible, so not XSLT, XPath or XPath Filter 2.0.

CamelXmlSignatureXAdESQualifyingProperti.description: The Id attribute of the XAdES QualifyingProperties element. Only used by the signer when the properties option is an XAdESSignatureProperties. If not set, the element has no Id attribute.

CamelXmlSignatureXAdESSignedDataObjectPr.description: The Id attribute of the XAdES SignedDataObjectProperties element. Only used by the signer when the properties option is an XAdESSignatureProperties. If not set, the element has no Id attribute.

CamelXmlSignatureXAdESSignedSignaturePro.description: The Id attribute of the XAdES SignedSignatureProperties element. Only used by the signer when the properties option is an XAdESSignatureProperties. If not set, the element has no Id attribute.

CamelXmlSignatureXAdESDataObjectFormatEn.description: The text of the Encoding element of the XAdES DataObjectFormat element. Only used by the signer when the properties option is an XAdESSignatureProperties that adds a DataObjectFormat element. If not set, there is no Encoding element.

CamelXmlSignatureXAdESNamespace.description: The namespace of the XAdES elements, which selects the XAdES version: http://uri.etsi.org/01903/v1.1.1#, http://uri.etsi.org/01903/v1.2.2# or http://uri.etsi.org/01903/v1.3.2#. Replaces the namespace of the XAdESSignatureProperties of the properties option. Only used by the signer.

CamelXmlSignatureXAdESPrefix.description: The namespace prefix of the XAdES elements; an empty value means no prefix. Replaces the prefix of the XAdESSignatureProperties of the properties option, which is etsi by default. Only used by the signer.

CamelCharsetName.description: The character encoding of the output body, which the signer and the default xmlSignature2Message of the verifier set when outputXmlEncoding is set. Not removed by clearHeaders.

producerIn.description: The XML document to sign: text, bytes, a stream, a file or a DOM Document. A Map, a POJO that is not XML or no body fails: marshal it first. With plainText (or the CamelXmlSignatureMessageIsPlainText header) the body is any text, which an enveloping signature wraps

producerOut.description: The signed XML document as bytes, in the outputXmlEncoding when set: the document with the signature for enveloped and detached, or the Signature element with the payload inside for enveloping

name.description: The name of the endpoint, chosen freely to tell endpoints apart. The component does not use it otherwise.

addKeyInfoReference.description: Whether to add a reference to the KeyInfo element to the SignedInfo element, so that the signature value also protects the KeyInfo element against changes. Only used when keyAccessor returns a KeyInfo with an Id; DefaultKeyAccessor does so when the keystore has a certificate chain for the alias.

baseUri.description: The base URI that relative URIs of the references are resolved against, set on the XMLSignContext of the signer and the XMLValidateContext of the verifier (XMLCryptoContext.setBaseURI).
